verifications.claim: ChatGPT experienced a major, temporary partial outage affecting conversational history and access for thousands of users as of early April 20, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Users unable to load ChatGPT... Elevated errors for ChatGPT conversations'; R3: 'ChatGPT was down for thousands... partial outage... unable to load conversation... started at about 10.05am ET / 3.05pm on April 20'; R5: 'thousands of users reporting issues... unable to load ChatGPT'; R6: 'Something went wrong... around 10 am ET on April 20... unable to access ChatGPT'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm partial outage on April 20 affecting access and conversations/history for thousands, all resolved (temporary).

verifications.claim: ChatGPT services are currently recovering or fully back online for most users.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'All impacted services have now fully recovered' (multiple April 20 incidents); R2: 'We’re fully operational'; R3: 'ChatGPT now seems to be back for many... the worst... behind us'; R6: 'ChatGPT appears to be mostly working... We have applied the mitigation and are monitoring the recovery'; R7: 'User reports show no current problems'
